In this paper, we present MobileWave a framework that allows to create, compose and publish RDF streams from smart phones. MobileWave extends TripleWave with a publish/subscribe middleware that collects affluent RDF Streams, composes them into an swollen RDF stream to publish it on the Web.

title: Exploring Data Quality of Wikidata Through View and Edit Information
abstract: Past research has shown the importance of "readers" in Wikipedia as part of the community. Visiting the online encyclopedia without actively contributing could be in many cases a first form of peripheral participation, which may lead to a more active engagement. Wikidata has a participation model which is very similar to Wikipedia. However, visits to Wikidata are likely to be lower with respect to Wikipedia. This may be due to the early stage of development in which Wikidata is, but also to its inherent peculiarities, since it is surely more pleasant to read an article than a list of triples. If Wikidata's pages are not visited enough, the principle that "given enough eyeballs, all bugs are shallow" may not apply anymore, i.e. this will harm the future development of Wikidata. Therefore we look in detail into the visit and edit numbers to get a better understanding of the state of Wikidata contributions in comparison to Wikipedia.

title: JedAI: The Force behind Entity Resolution
abstract: We present JedAI, a toolkit that can be used in three ways: as an open source Java library that implements numerous state of the art, domain independent methods for Entity Resolution (ER), as a desktop application that offers out of the box ER solutions and as a workbench that facilitates the evaluation of the relative performance of ER workflows. JedAI bridges the gap between the database and the Semantic Web communities, offering solutions that are applicable to both relational and RDF data. It also conveys a modular architecture that facilitates its extension with more methods and with more comprehensive workflows.

title: Context Aware and Self Learning Dynamic Transport Scheduling in Hospitals
abstract: The increase in available ICT infrastructure in hospitals offers cost reduction opportunities by optimizing various workflows, while maintaining quality of care. In this demonstrator paper, we present a self learning dashboard, for monitoring and learning the cause of delays of hospital transports. By identifying these causes, future delays in transport time can be avoided.

title: RML and FnO: Shaping DBpedia Declaratively
abstract: DBpedia data is largely generated from extracting and parsing the wikitext from the infoboxes of Wikipedia. This generation process is handled by the DBpedia Extraction Framework (DBpedia EF). This framework currently consists of data transformations, a series of custom hard coded steps which parse the wikitext, and schema transformations, which model the resulting RDF data. Therefore, applying changes to the resulting RDF data needs both Semantic Web expertise and development within the DBpedia EF. As such, the current DBpedia data is being shaped by a small amount of core developers. However, by describing both schema and data transformations declaratively, we shape and generate the dbpedia data using solely declarations, splitting the concerns between implementation and modeling. The parsing functions development is decoupled from the DBpedia EF, and other data transformation functions can easily be integrated during DBpedia data generation. This demo showcases an interactive Web application that allows non technical users to (re )shape the DBpedia data and use external data transformation functions, solely by editing the mapping document via HTML controls.

title: Building Soccer Matches Timelines from Twitter
abstract: This demo paper presents a system that builds a timeline with salient actions of a soccer game, based on the tweets posted by users. It combines information provided by external knowledge bases to enrich the content of tweets and applies graph theory to model relations between actions (e.g. goals, penalties) and participants of a game (e.g. players, teams). In the demo, a web application displays in nearly real time the actions detected from tweets posted by users for a given match.

title: Instantly Serving Triple Pattern Fragments over Tabular and Tree structured Datasources with RML
abstract: A complex linked data generation process is often required for datasets to support a triple pattern fragment interface, or any other kind of queryable interface for linked data such as a SPARQL endpoint. Even when the generation workflow is straightforward, executing the workflow causes a delay, and thus the linked data representation is not always well synchronized with the original data sources. In this paper, we present an approach to serve tabular and tree structured data as linked data through triple pattern fragments to instantly publish linked data. Our approach allows adding queryable semantics to various types of heterogeneous data sources with reusable mapping definitions following the RDF Mapping Language (RML) without the need of additional storage for the generated triples. As soon as a mapping document is ready, it can be loaded during the start up of a Linked Data Fragments (LDF) server and make data available that remains only in the original relational database, or in local/remote CSV, XML, JSON files. The implementation in progress indicates that this approach introduces limited overhead in terms of set up time and requires little additional resources for existing infrastructures to host the linked data.

title: DrIveSCOVER: A tourism recommender based on external driving factors
abstract: In this paper, we present the design and implementation of a recommending system for points of interest and activities in the case of an in car use, where the driving conditions such as the weather and local traffic are taken into account. We integrate multiple data sources using semantic technologies and we devise recommending functions that are presented in a web based application. Data is organized according to five roots classes: accommodation, amenity, events, gastronomy and points of interest. The accuracy of the system is evaluated and compared with other systems.

title: Improving Outlier Detection and Classication through Semantic Web Technologies
abstract: Outlier detection has been a widely researched topic for many years. However, conventional outlier detection methods might still overlook outliers in certain contexts. Besides, identifying the potential outlier cause still remains an unsolved challenge even though it could be very helpful for determining what action to perform after detecting them. In this article, Semantic Web Technologies (SWT) are proposed to contribute overcoming this problem and to improve both the detection and classication of outliers. Feasibility of the proposed knowledge based outlier detection has been tested in a temperature sensing device use case. Results show that Semantic Web Technologies have a big potential to contribute in outlier detection and even classication tasks.

title: Generation automatique dun questionnaire a partir dune ontologie de domaine
abstract: Lusage croissant des ontologies dans les applications informatiques pose le probleme de lestimation de la qualite de ces ontologies et de leur adequation par rapport au probleme quelles contribuent a resoudre. La validation dune ontologie verifie que la semantique des definitions modelise la realite pour laquelle lontologie a ete developpee. Etant donne que le langage naturel est considere comme un moyen incontournable de transfert de la connaissance et que les experts du domaine ne maitrisent pas forcement les langages formels des ontologies, une des techniques de validation les plus utilisees est le questionnaire en langage naturel. Dans cet article, nous proposons un systeme de generation automatique de questionnaire a partir dontologies dans le cadre dune approche devaluation des ontologies proposee dans un travail anterieur. Le resultat de ce systeme est un questionnaire destine a representer les composants de lontologie de facon informelle afin detre evalues par les experts du domaine.

title: Une plate forme visuelle pour une information comparative sur les nouveaux medicaments
abstract: Resume Lorsqu'un nouveau medicament arrive sur le marche, les medecins doivent decider s'ils le considereront pour leurs prescriptions futures ou non. La bonne decision depend des proprietes du nouveau medicament, des medicaments deja existants dans la meme indication, mais aussi de la pratique du medecin et de sa patientele. Elle est difficile a prendre car une part importante de l'information sur les nouveaux medicaments provient de l'industrie pharmaceutique et n'est donc pas independante. Nous proposons ici un systeme visuel d'aide a la decision pour aider le medecin dans ce contexte, a partir d'une information independante, objective et fiable. Resume Le systeme presente repose d'une part sur une ontologie comparative du medicament, qui permet la comparaison des proprietes du nouveau medicament avec celles des medicaments existants similaires, et d'autre part sur des techniques de visualisation de connaissance permettant de comparer en un coup d'oeil les proprietes de plusieurs medicaments. Nous presentons ici un prototype incluant 4 nouveaux medicaments et 22 medicaments comparateurs. L'evaluation de ce prototype par un groupe de 22 medecins generalistes montre que ce systeme visuel permet aux medecins de se forger leur propre opinion sur les nouveaux medicaments, et de changer d'avis sur certains medicaments.

title: Concepts de plus proches voisins dans des graphes de connaissances
abstract: Nous introduisons la notion de "concept de voisins" comme alternative a la notion de distance numerique dans le but d'identifier les objets les plus similaires a un objet requete, comme dans la methode des plus proches voisins. Chaque concept de voisins est compose d'une intension qui decrit symboliquement ce que deux objets ont en commun et d'une extension qui englobe les objets qui se trouvent entre les deux. Nous definissons ces concepts de voisins pour des donnees complexes, les graphes de connaissances, ou les noeuds jouent le role d'objets. Nous decrivons un algorithme anytime permettant d'affronter la complexite elevee de la tache et nous presentons de premieres experimentations sur un graphe RDF de plus de 120.000 triplets.

title: Graphe de connaissances et folksonomie : leur performance comparative dans le calcul de l'affinite
abstract: Laffinite est un element essentiel dans bien des systemes dinformation centres sur lutilisateur comme les systemes de recommandation. Le graphe de connaissances et la folksonomie sont respectivement des jalons importants pour le Web Semantique et le Web Social. Nonobstant leur trait collaboratif partage (du moins quelques grands graphes de connaissances le sont), les donnees codees different tant par la nature (fait versus experience) que par la structure (formelle versus lache). Dans ce papier, nous tentons de faire lumiere sur leur performance comparative dans la tache du calcul de laffinite a travers deux experiences dans le domaine du e tourisme. Nos resultats montrent que le graphe de connaissances permet de calculer laffinite avec plus de precision alors que la folksonomie augmente la diversite et la nouveaute. Ces constatations nous ont motives a developper le Framework dAffinite Semantique pour recolter leurs avantages respectifs. Loriginal de ce papier est publie par ESWC 2017.

title: Vers une Ecole dIngenieur Etendue : Capital relationnel et opportunites du web social. Cas ESI, Alger
abstract: Les organisations mettent a profit lintelligence collective a travers les connaissances et les competences des acteurs tant internes qu'externes pour innover a travers des nouveaux produits ou services. Les etablissements universitaires et plus particulierement les ecoles dingenieurs se focalisent de plus en plus sur leurs relations avec lecosysteme pour reussir leurs missions statutaires de base : enseignement et recherche scientifique. Ce papier presente le cas ESI Alger comme une ecole etendue en decrivant le systeme dIntelligence Collective focalise sur sa mission Innovation, entreprenariat, transfert technologique et engagement social . Une cartographie des processus existants, du capital relationnel et des types dusages des outils du web social sont mises en relief.

title: ADEL : une methode adaptative de desambiguisation d'entites nommees pour l'extraction de connaissances
abstract: Nous identifions quatre criteres principaux pouvant causer de serieuses difficultes lorsqu'il s'agit de developper un systeme de desambiguisation d'entites nommees : i) la nature du document a analyser (tweet, sous titre d'une video, article de presse, etc.); ii) le nombre de types possibles qui sont utilises pour categoriser une mention (Personne, Lieu, Date, Role, etc.); iii) la base de connaissances utilisee pour desambiguiser les mentions extraites (DBpedia, Wikidata, Musicbrainz, etc.); iv) la langue utilisee dans le document. Dans cet article, nous presentons ADEL, une approche innovante basee sur une architecture hybride pour un systeme de desambiguisation d'entites nommees combinant des methodes du domaine du Traitement Automatique du Langage Naturel (TALN), de la recherche d'information et du Web Semantique. En particulier, nous proposons une approche modulaire afin d'etre aussi independants que possible du texte analyse et de la base de connaissance utilisee. Notre evaluation montre que ce systeme obtient des resultats comparables ou meilleurs que l'etat de l'art sur cinq jeux de donnees : OKE2015, OKE2016, NEEL2014, NEEL2015 et NEEL2016. Pour conclure, nous identifions les limitations actuelles, et fournissons des directions a prendre pour ameliorer le systeme.

title: Identification de regles pour renforcer la detection de verite
abstract: Pour contrer les dangers de la desinformation, un domaine de recherche a emerge ces dernieres annees : la detection de verite sur le Web. Heritiere de la verification de faits (fact checking) d'une part et des techniques de fusion de donnees d'autre part, la detection de verite analyse les declarations (i.e. <sujet, predicat, valeur>) diffusees par plusieurs sources sur un sujet donne, et tente de determiner parmi toutes ces declarations, celle qui constitue un fait (une verite). Nous avons recemment montre que la prise en compte d'axiomes fournis par une ontologie de domaine, et en particulier certaines relations transitives, constitue une reelle plus value et permet d'ameliorer la performance des approches existantes. Dans cet article, nous enrichissons nos travaux precedents en etendant l'analyse a d'autres types de relations, pouvant participer a l'identification de regles pour renforcer la confiance dans certaines declarations et ainsi ameliorer l'identification de verite. A partir d'une base de connaissances, un ensemble de regles est extrait. Un coefficient propulseur (booster) est alors calcule pour renforcer certaines declarations. Les premiers resultats de l'evaluation montrent une plus value par rapport aux approches traditionnelles.

title: Recommandation de ressources pedagogiques au sein dun systeme de systemes dinformation
abstract: Avec le developpement des technologies de linformation et de la communication, les organisations sont confrontees a une grande quantite dinformations issues de nombreux systemes. Identifier une ressource dinformation pertinente en fonction dun contexte precis devient un vrai challenge. Dans le cadre de notre travail nous nous interessons aux ecosystemes apprenants et a la recommandation de ressources pedagogiques. Nous avons fait le choix de modeliser un ecosysteme apprenant comme un systeme de systemes dinformation au sein duquel nous introduisons un systeme de recommandation de ressources base sur le vote des acteurs (apprenants, enseignants) de lecosysteme. Dans notre approche, nous tenons compte de qui recommande quoi a qui sur quel sujet, quand, comment et pourquoi. Nous le faisons au moyen du modele de collaboration memorae core2 mis en uvre pour la conception du SoIS support a lecosysteme apprenant. Dans cet article nous precisons notre problematique, justifions notre approche SoIS et presentons la mise en uvre du modele memorae core2 pour la conception du SoIS memorae.

title: Formalisation de la terminologie LOINC et evaluation de ses avantages pour la classification des tests de laboratoire
abstract: La numerisation croissante des donnees medicales a fait emerger de nouveaux standards pour representer linformation au sein des dossiers patients informatises. Dans le domaine du diagnostic in vitro, deux standards semantiques sont recommandes pour coder les descriptions des tests de laboratoire (la terminologie LOINC) et les resultats obtenus (l'ontologie SNOMED CT). La structuration non formelle des tests et labsence de relations hierarchiques au sein de LOINC limitent les capacites dinterrogation et de reutilisation des donnees du diagnostic in vitro au sein des dossiers patients. Lobjectif de ce travail est devaluer les avantages Lobjectif de ce travail est devaluer les avantages dune representation formelle permettant de decrire et de classer automatiquement les tests de laboratoire. Dans cet article, nous presentons ontoLOINC, une representation ontologique de LOINC et les processus de generation que nous avons mis en place. Dans un second temps, nous comparons les classifications des tests dans ontoLOINC et dans un formalisme fonde sur SNOMED CT (LOINCSCT). La formalisation des tests et la classification des elements utilises dans leur definition permet dobtenir des classifications coherentes avec la terminologie.

title: Extraction de relations : Exploiter des techniques complementaires pour mieux s'adapter au type de texte
abstract: Extraire des relations d'hyperonymies de textes est une des etapes cles de la construction automatique d'ontologies ou du peuplement de base de connaissances. Des plateformes de construction d'ontologie a partir de textes proposent plusieurs types de techniques (patrons lexico syntaxiques, techniques a base d'apprentissage, supervise ou non) afin de jouer sur leur complementarite pour extraire plus de relations. L'ensemble du corpus y est traite de facon uniforme sans tenir compte de son heterogeneite. Nous proposons de prendre en compte cette heterogeneite en adaptant les techniques d'extraction les plus pertinentes a chaque type de textes formant le corpus. Nous appliquons cette approche au corpus Wikipedia en francais, et presentons dans cet article un premier travail sur les pages d'homonymies, dont la structure particuliere permet de definir des patrons specifiques et d'entrainer un classifieur MaxEnt. Nous comparons les resultats obtenus par ces deux techniques et montrons leur complementarite.

title: Decouverte de co clusters avec presence ou absence de proprietes
abstract: Dans cet article, nous definissons une methode de co clustering appelee BiP qui produit quelques variantes de co clusters a partir d'un graphe biparti issu d'une matrice a valeurs binaires. Cette methode presente les caracteristiques suivantes : chaque bloc genere peut representer un groupe d'objets (i) avec les proprietes qu'il possede, (ii) avec les attributs qu'il ne possede pas, (iii) ayant un melange de 0 et 1 et plus precisement une juxtaposition de sous groupes avec des profils distincts (et parfois purement opposes) pour un sous ensemble d'attributs, ou (iv) avec les proprietes qu'il possede et ceux qu'il ne possede pas. Ce sont ces deux dernieres variantes non communes que nous allons presenter d'une maniere detaillee.

title: Placement des taches materielles dans les systemes embarquees partiellement reconfigurables par les algorithmes genetiques
abstract: Les evolutions technologiques actuelles permettent d'integrer plusieurs composants (processeurs, accelerateurs materiels et unites reconfigurables) sur une meme puce dans le but d'accelerer l'execution des applications sur les unites de traitement. Lors de l'execution de tel applications, il faut determiner quelles ressources vont etre utilisees et a quel moment. L'ordonnancement spatial (ou placement) sur architectures partiellement reconfigurables de type FPGA s'avere quant a lui bien plus complexe du moment quil est necessaire de determiner une zone accueillant une tache materielle. Pour placer ces taches, l'ordonnanceur ou le placeur leur a attribuees un emplacement. Le choix de cet emplacement peut etre effectue selon divers criteres. L'un des criteres les plus courants vise a maximiser le nombre de taches a placer sur le FPGA tout en minimisant la distance dans le FPGA entre ces taches communicantes. Dans ce cas, le placement de taches revient a placer un maximum de rectangles au sein d'un rectangle, ce qui peut etre assimilee au probleme Bin Packing, qui est prouve comme NP Complet probleme. Des heuristiques sont utilisees afin de minimiser le surcout de l'algorithme de placement. Notre objectif est de placer un nombre maximal de taches presentant des contraintes temporelles, spatiales et de dependance sur un espace reconfigurable de type FPGA. Pour atteindre cet objectif, notre choix est porte sur les algorithmes genetiques. Les resultats trouves prouvent lefficacite de lapproche adoptee.

title: Un modele pour la representation des connaissances temporelles dans les documents historiques : Applications sur les manuscrits de F.Saussure
abstract: Les donnees des sciences historiques et sociales constituent une source potentielle dexploitation pour le web semantique. La modelisation du contenu de ces donnees sous formes de connaissances ontologiques permet de faire des traitements avances. Ces donnees sont souvent riches en matieres susceptibles devoluer a travers le temps. On sinteresse a l'utilisation des techniques du web semantique pour le raisonnement temporel historique. Dans ce papier, on traite le cas des manuscrits de Ferdinand de Saussure mais ce modele peut etre applique sur dautres travaux.

title: L'ontologie Port History Ontology PHO dediee a l'histoire des ports
abstract: Nos travaux de recherche en histoire des ports et humanites numeriques s'in teressent plus particulierement a l'articulation de deux points : i) Cote SHS, la conception d'un modele de periodisation et de comparaison des ports en histoire developpe a partirdu modele ANYPORT issu de travaux de geographes ; ii) Cote representation des connaissances et web semantique : la conception d'une ontologie de reference pour l'histoire des ports reutilisant notamment l'ontologie CIDOC CRM pour la valorisation du patrimoine des musees. Les principales contributions de notre travail de recherche sont : i) Un modele de periodisation des ports developpee a partir de travaux de geographes (ANY PORT). Ce dernier apporte les evolutions necessaires pour s'inscrive en histoire des sciences et techniques ; ii) Une methodologie de conception de l'ontologie de reference fondee sur le modele de periodisation des ports ; iii) Une ontologie de reference, appele Port History Ontology (PHO) dont les classes, les proprietes et la structure sont issues du modele de periodisation des ports. Par ailleurs, PHO reutilise des elements pertinents du CIDOC CRM.

title: Ontologie et TALN : la desidentification au service du reperage conceptuel dans le contexte de la SLA
abstract: La Sclerose Laterale Amyotrophique est une maladie neurodegenerative creant des atteintes polymorphes (physique, respiratoire, cognitive) rendant la prise en soins complexe, dans le cadre du suivi des patients un reseau ressource fut mis en place en Ile de France, le reseau SLA IDF. Ce reseau dispose, depuis 2005, dune base de donnees dites evenementielles retracant les demandes, besoins des patients et professionnels et les actions mises en place pour repondre a ces besoins. Lobjectif de notre travail est dutiliser les outils de lingenierie des connaissances et du traitement automatique de la langue naturelle, pour exploiter ce corpus pour comprendre, decrire les parcours de sante et identifier les points de fragilite et les leviers pour ameliorer la continuite des parcours de sante et prevenir les ruptures. Differentes etapes sont necessaires pour atteindre cet objectif, notamment la creation dune ontologie du domaine, la realisation de pretraitements, comme la desidentification, la correction dorthographe et le reperage des cas hypothetiques et nies.

title: OntoCoins : donnees ouvertes liees pour la numismatique, patrimoine culturel
abstract: Le patrimoine culturel est en partie conserve dans des collections publiques et privees difficilement accessibles au grand public ainsi quaux chercheurs, historiens de lart, economistes, ou archeologues, qui trouvent la un frein majeur a leurs recherches. Nous sommes aujourdhui en mesure de partager et de valoriser ce patrimoine par le biais du Web semantique et des donnees ouvertes liees sous limpulsion du Ministere de la Culture. Dans cet article, nous developpons un vocabulaire qui a pour vocation douvrir les donnees numismatiques , cest a dire des donnees relatives aux monnaies anciennes, veritables uvres dart realises par des artistes graveurs, temoins de levolution des cultures depuis plus de deux millenaires, dont seule une petite partie (dans le meilleur des cas) est exposee au public a travers les vitrines des musees. La conception et le developpement de notre vocabulaire baptise OntoCoins sont traites dans cet article. Lapplication Wikimoneda a ete developpee pour montrer la pertinence du vocabulaire, et est dores et deja alimentee (et consultee) par cinq des plus importants conservateurs de collections publiques collaborant dans ce travail.

title: Peuplement dune base de connaissance par annotation automatique de textes relatifs a la cosmetique
abstract: Dans cet article, nous proposons une approche pour construire une base de connaissances a partir de textes dans le domaine de la cosmetique. Le defi est lextraction des relations a partir de textes dans un domaine donne. Dans le but de resoudre ce probleme, nous proposons une approche semi supervisee pour lextraction des relations en combinant deux methodes: (i) la construction de patrons dextraction a partir des resumes presents dans les pages de DBpedia, (ii) lannotation manuelle dun ensemble de textes pour definir des patrons syntaxiques pour extraire les relations. Nous avons evalue notre approche sur deux types de corpus :(i) un premier corpus est compose darticles de journaux specialises, tels que aufeminin.com et Cosmetique Hebdo, (ii) un deuxieme corpus est constitue dun ensemble de phrases collectees sur sur le Web.

title: Suivi et detection des ideations suicidaires dans les medias sociaux
abstract: L'utilisation croissante des medias sociaux permet un acces sans precedent aux comportements, aux pensees et aux sentiments des individus. Nous nous interessons ici a l'evolution des etats emotionnels des individus captes au travers des services de microblogging de type Twitter. Notre objectif est de predire l'apparition d'ideations suicidaires. Dans ce travail, nous avons mis en place une chaine de traitements permettant d'extraire des caracteristiques a partir des messages refletant l'etat emotionnel. Puis, nous appliquons un modele base sur les Conditionnal Random Fields pour predire un nouvel etat. L'originalite de l'approche est de prendre en compte l'historique des etats emotionnels pour predire le nouvel etat. Une experimentation preliminaire nous a permis d'evaluer notre approche sur des cas reels d'utilisateurs de Twitter. Ces type d'approche permet de mieux comprendre les liens entre expressions dans les medias sociaux et ideations suicidaires ainsi que les transitions entre etats emotionnels.

title: STDFR: Systeme de Traitement Distribue de Flux de graphes RDF
abstract: Dans ce travail, nous presentons STDFR un systeme de traitement distribue de flux de graphes RDF. Le systeme implemente entre autres trois principaux algorithmes pour (1) la reecriture de requetes ayant des patterns communs, (2) le partitionnement de requetes SPARQL sur plusieurs noeuds de traitement suivant une strategie de parallelisation et (3) le partitionnement de graphes RDF base requete pour un traitement local des sous requetes afin de minimiser les couts de communication entre les noeuds de traitement. STDFR combine a la fois des donnees statiques et dynamiques provenant de sources multiples et diverses. Levaluation des performances du systeme est effectuee sur un ensemble de donnees reelles contenant jusqua 1 million de graphes RDF. Les experiences realisees et les resultats obtenus confirment la scalabilite du systeme.

title: Un jeu de donnees d'evaluation de correspondances complexes entre ontologies
abstract: Le web de donnees liees se compose d'entrepots de donnees decrits par des ontologies. Ces ontologies heterogenes ont differents niveaux de disparite (differences terminologiques, de conceptualisation, de modelisation). Les alignements simples font correspondre une entite de l'ontologie source a une entite de l'ontologie cible. Ils ne permettent pas d'exprimer tous les niveaux de disparite. Les alignements complexes, completent les alignements simples en exprimant plus finement les differents types de disparites. Les approches permettant de detecter des correspondances complexes entre ontologies sont peu nombreuses et il n'existe pas encore de jeu de donnees exhaustif pour les evaluer. Cet article presente un jeu de donnees d'alignements complexes entre deux paires d'ontologies du domaine de l'organisation de conferences, ainsi qu'une evaluation d'approches d'alignement permettant d'obtenir de telles correspondances.

title: Query based exploration of domain ontologies adapted to user profiles
abstract: With the ever increasing number of ontologies published on the web, users need solutions to facilitate their exploration. This paper proposes an automatic process for the generation of natural language descriptions of domain ontologies, which allows a specific user to be able to understand what a given ontology is trying to describe and represent, which are their classes, properties or instances that best represent it, that is, those that contain as much information value as possible for him/her. As the needs depend on the user, we define user profiles for which we develop specific strategies. We experiment our approach on the Product Vocabulary (ProVoc) ontology. The results are encouraging.

title: Une approche hybride pour la detection d'influenceurs dans les medias sociaux
abstract: Un influenceur est une personne ayant les capacites d'imposer des attitudes, des comportements, des opinions a un public. La detection de tels individus est d'un grand interet, par exemple pour les campagnes commerciales qui cherchent a identifier les acteurs les plus influents pour promouvoir une marque ou un produit. Dans cet article, nous nous focalisons sur la detection d'influenceurs dans les reseaux sociaux qui s'appuie generalement sur une structure de graphe dont les nuds sont les utilisateurs et les arcs orientes sont leurs interactions. Au dela de la structure du graphe, nous experimentons l'impact du contenu textuel des messages sur l'influence. En considerant des criteres linguistiques hypothetiques (tels que l'argumentation d'un utilisateur, l'accord/desaccord entre utilisateurs) en plus des criteres numeriques classiques (nombre de reponses, taille du message, nombre de relations, etc.), nous montrons par le biais d'un systeme d'apprentissage que certains criteres linguistiques sont pertinents pour la tache de detection d'influenceurs.

title: Infarctus du myocarde : quelles sont les trajectoires de soins pronostiques du deces a l'hopital?
abstract: Les maladies cardiovasculaires representent la premiere cause de mortalite dans le monde. En France, environ 120 000 personnes sont atteintes dinfarctus du myocarde par an; 12 000 en decedent lors de la crise, et 18 000 personnes en seront decedees un an apres. Prevenir le risque de deces lie a linfarctus du myocarde est un des objectifs que nous nous sommes fixes. Nous proposons une methode pour identifier les parcours de soins les plus pronostiques du deces hospitalier. A partir des donnees medico administratives issues du PMSI, nous extrayons des motifs sequentiels frequents et nous les integrons dans un processus de prediction du deces par un score mesurant la similarite entre la trajectoire du patient et chacun des motifs extraits. Les resultats obtenus nous ont permis de mettre en evidence limportance de la surveillance et du suivi de ces patients longtemps apres leur infarctus.

title: Assister l'utilisateur pour expliciter un modele de trace a l'aide de l'analyse de concepts formels
abstract: Dans cet article, nous proposons d'analyser des jeux de donnees representant des traces afin de decouvrir le modele sous jacent et assister leur integration dans un systeme a base de traces. Ce principe est mis en oeuvre dans csv2ktbs, un prototype interactif qui s'appuie sur l'analyse de concepts formels pour generer un modele de la trace et assister un utilisateur dans le processus d'integration dans un systeme a base de traces. L'utilisateur intervient principalement pour l'interpretation des concepts qui lui sont proposes a partir de l'analyse des traces, mais aussi pour valider les autres resultats obtenus par l'analyse. Ces principes ont ete appliques aux traces du jeu serieux Tamagocours pour l'apprentissage des regles juridiques de diffusion de ressources numeriques ainsi qu'aux traces de ClassCraft, une application ludique pour l'enseignement secondaire.

title: Mesurer la qualite des systemes de categories de blogs
abstract: Dans le monde prolifique de la blogosphere, retrouver une information pertinente est un defi. Pour aider leurs lecteurs, les auteurs de blog annotent souvent leurs billets avec des categories mais ce systeme de categories est difficile a maintenir quand le blog evolue au fil du temps. Pour guider la revision des annotations des blogs, nous proposons ici deux metriques, lequilibre et le cout dacces. Elles permettent de mesurer la qualite formelle des systemes de categories des blogs consideres comme des systemes dannotation. Nos experiences montrent quen raisonnant sur les caracteristiques du systeme dannotation et sur les mesures dequilibre et de cout quon obtient par calcul, on a une vue synthetique sur le systeme de categories a un instant 't' et des indications sur les ameliorations quon peut y apporter. Ces mesures sont concues pour etre integrees dans le systeme de revision interactive des annotations de blogs que nous developpons.

title: Apport des ontologies noyaux pour la modelisation des processus metier sensibles dans une perspective d'identification des connaissances
abstract: De nos jours, les organisations modernes se caracterisent par des processus collaboratifs, hautement dynamiques, complexes et a forte intensite de connaissances. Dans ce contexte, la modelisation des processus metier sensibles (SBPs) est devenue une preoccupation primordiale de toute organisation performante pour la gestion efficace de leur patrimoine de connaissances cruciales. Dans ce papier, nous proposons un nouveau meta modele de representation des processus metier dans une perspective de gestion de connaissances, que nous avons appele BPM4KI ( Busines Process Meta Model for Knowledge Identification ). Ce meta modele est semantiquement riche et bien fonde sur des ontologies noyaux de domaine. Ces ontologies nous a servi pour caracteriser et definir les concepts et dimensions utiles pour enrichir la modelisation des SBPs. BPM4KI couvre tous les aspects pertinents de modelisation des processus: les perspectives fonctionnelle, organisationnelle, comportementale, informationnelle, intentionnelle et connaissance. Son objectif consiste a developper une representation graphique riche et expressive des SBPs, afin d'ameliorer la localisation et l'identification des connaissances cruciales mobilisees et crees par ces processus. Par ailleurs, nous avons illustre lapplication du BPM4KI sur un processus medical dans le contexte dune association de sauvegarde des handicapes moteurs.

title: Modele de recherche d'information semantique en graphe : interrogation par propagation d'activation
abstract: La recherche dinformation semantique (RIS) cherche a depasser les approches classiques purement statistiques en injectant des connaissances de maniere a desambiguiser le vocabulaire ou enrichir la representation des documents et des requetes. Neanmoins, les modeles semantiques, senses permettre daller au dela des mots et raisonner a un niveau conceptuel, sont en fait eux memes aplatis. La representation des documents passe de sac de mots a sac de concepts . Nous proposons de modeliser les donnees semantiques et documentaires sous la forme de graphe pondere et l'interrogation comme une propagation dactivation dans ce graphe a partir des noeuds qui ont ete actives par la requete de lutilisateur. Cet algorithme a le merite de preserver les caracteristiques largement eprouvees des modeles classiques de recherche dinformation tout en permettant une representation adequate des modeles semantiques. La propagation dactivation sur ce graphe est le mecanisme qui assure la mise en correspondance entre le besoin de lutilisateur formule sous la forme dune requete et les documents. Selon que lon introduit ou pas de la semantique dans le graphe, cette approche permet de reproduire une RI classique ou assure en sus certaines fonctionnalites semantiques. Ces fonctionnalites sont validees experimentalement sur un corpus dans le domaine medical (Ohsumed87 ) qui permet de verifier le passage a lechelle de notre modele et de faire une premiere analyse qualitative et quantitative sur les performance de lalgorithme de propagation.

title: Detection de liens didentite contextuels dans une base de connaissances
abstract: De nombreuses applications du Web de donnees exploitent des liens d'identites declares a l'aide du constructeur owl:sameAs. Cependant, differentes etudes ont montre qu'une utilisation abusive de ces liens peut conduire a des inferences erronees ou contradictoires. Dans ce papier nous proposons de calculer des liens d'identites contextuels qui permettent d'expliciter les contextes dans lesquels ces liens sont valides. La notion de contexte que nous proposons est represente en se basant sur l'ontologie de domaine dans lesquels les instances sont representees. Nous avons experimentee cette approche dans le domaine des donnees scientifiques ou les elements decrivant les experiences partagent rarement un lien d'identite tel que defini par owl:sameAs.

title: Proposition dune ontologie modulaire pour la fabrication et lexploitation de vetements intelligents : Appliquee au Sport
abstract: Les vetements intelligents sont des vetements dotes de capteurs intelligents. Dans le domaine du sport, ils permettent de collecter des informations sur letat de forme des sportifs. La fabrication de tels vetements fait appel a plusieurs acteurs de disciplines differentes echangeant entre eux des donnees heterogenes. Pour faciliter le partage dinformations, nous proposons dans cet article une ontologie modulaire appelee SMS. Cette ontologie est utilisee dans le systeme SmartSensing pour le monitoring sportif. Les connaissances de ce systeme sont conceptualisees dans les differents modules de lontologie. Ces modules sont bases sur une reutilisation ontologique et representent les differents aspects contribuant a la description dun vetement intelligent. Ils sont utilises dans des scenarii de fabrication et dexploitation de ces vetements. Dans cet article nous presentons lontologie SMS et son usage durant la pratique dun sport avec un vetement intelligent.

title: Approche numerique pour linvalidation de liens didentite (owl:SameAs)
abstract: Au cours des dernieres annees, grace a la standardisation des technologies Web semantique, nous connaissons une production de donnees sans precedent, publiees en ligne sous forme de donnees liees. Dans ce contexte, lorsquun lien type est declare entre deux ressources distinctes faisant reference a la meme entite du monde reel, lutilisation du owl :sameAs est generalement predominant. Toutefois, des travaux recents dans la communaute des donnees liees ont montre des problemes dans lutilisation des liens owl :sameAs. Les problemes surviennent a la fois dans les cas ou ces liens sont errones ou lorsquils traduisent un lien moins strict que la semantique des liens owl :SameAs definie dans OWL. Dans ce travail, nous presentons une methode dinvalidation numerique de liens didentite sappuyant sur un calcul de similarite et sur des axiomes de lontologie pour detecter des liens didentite invalides. Nous presentons nos premiers resultats experimentaux, obtenus sur un jeu de donnees de la competition internationale OAEI.

title: Le projet ECOPACK : environnement socio technique support a une analyse strategique
abstract: Le projet ECOPACK : environnement socio technique support a une analyse strategique

title: Du langage naturel a la connaissance il ny a quun pas : SWIP
abstract: Lapplication SWIP (dont plusieurs aspects ont ete presentes a la conference IC ces dernieres annees) permet linterrogation de base de connaissances a partir de requetes exprimees en langage naturel. Lutilisation de patron permet a SWIP detre coherent lors de linterpretation des questions. Ce papier de demo vise a presenter la derniere version de lapplication qui simplifie son deploiement et rend son implementation modulaire. Cette derniere version a ete utilisee pour deployer SWIP sur une base de connaissances utilisee dans le cadre de lacces aux donnees collectees par un batiment connecte.

title: Systeme de systemes dinformation et ecosysteme apprenant
abstract: Systeme de systemes dinformation et ecosysteme apprenant

title: Un outil de categorisation conceptuelle des formations professionnelles
abstract: Un outil de categorisation conceptuelle des formations professionnelles

title: ADEL at OKE2017
abstract: Participating to the three first task of the OKE2017 challenge reveal two difficulties for our entity linking system: i) the number of types used to extract an entity that includes generic fine grained types (such as Activity, Competition, Animal) for the task 2, and musical types (such as MusicArtist, SignalGroup, MusicalWork) for the task 3; ii) the knowledge bases that are DBpedia for the two first tasks and Musicbrainz for the third one. In this paper, we present the newest version of ADEL, our adaptive entity recognition and linking framework, where we experiment with an hybrid approach mixing extraction methods to improve the recognition level and an efficient knowledge base indexing process to increase the efficiency of the linking step. We obtain promising results on the OKE 2017 challenge training dataset of the three first tasks.

title: HmaraNER: A Named Entity Recognizer and Linker
abstract: This paper describes our system, HmaraNER for the ESWC Open Knowledge Extraction Challenge 2017 Task 1. HmaraNER is a rule based system that combines and filters the annotations from a semantic tagger, a named entity recognizer, and a part of speech tagger to produce improved results for the recognition and knowledge base linking of named Person/Place/Organization entities in an English text. For the challenge training dataset, HmaraNER scores F measure 0.95 for entity recognition task and F measure 0.78 for entity linking task.

title: JU CSE NLP at OKE 2017:Focused Musical NE Recognition and Linking using Universal Dependency
abstract: The task of knowledge extraction falls under the area of Natural Language Processing. We have tried to design a system that recognises Focused Musical Named Entities and classifies them according to Music Ontology and links them to a knowledge base using some predefined rules and universal dependencies that has been derived by Stanford Parser for every given sentence.

title: A new approximate reasoning for multi bases symbolic data
abstract: Approximate reasoning aims to manage knowledge imprecision in the inference process. It is a generalization of the Modus Ponens of classical logic. Originally, it is defined in fuzzy logic context, where knowledge are modeled by a quantitative way. We are interested in this paper to approximate reasoning in the symbolic multi valued logic context. This logic allows presenting imprecise knowledge in a qualitative way, where every predicate is modeled by a multi set. In order to express imprecision, each multi set is associated to a scale base of ordered symbolic degrees. In a previous work where we defined a symbolic approximate reasoning, we supposed that all multi sets of the inference schema have the same scale base. This has the disadvantage to prevent freely defining knowledge. For that, we propose in this paper a new approximate reasoning which can infer with multi sets having different scale bases. Our solution consists of interfacing all the multi sets in order to avoid information loss.

title: Decision Aid System based on Knowledges and Fuzzy Cognitive Maps
abstract: In order to support decision making within a company and the multitude of knowledge it can gather, we realized that a data warehouse could not provide recommendations or advice to decision making only from the explicit knowledge that it retrieves from its different data sources. However, within a company, some tacit knowledge also exists and must be included in any decision making process. Since these latter knowledges are difficult to formalize and to communicate among humans, knowledge management has made it possible to combine them with explicit knowledge in order to exploit them better. However, this process is not yet able to predict their effect for subsequent decision making. Thus, we had the idea of using fuzzy cognitive maps, a model that is clearly representative and understandable by humans and allows analysis of ideas and prediction of results in order to help in decision making.

title: Unsupervised Graph based Method for semantic Disambiguation of Spoken Arabic Words
abstract: The word sense disambiguation is an important task in many areas. This task has been applied on text, and a lot of work has been done for several languages including the Arabic language. However, until now we have not found in the literature any work that applies the word sense disambiguation on Arabic speech. We understand that it is due to the complexity and the difficulty of the task and the language. In this paper we propose a graph based approach for word sense disambiguation in Arabic speech. We use 1,000 ambiguous words in the test data speech. Finally, we obtain a disambiguation rate of 46,1%, which seems fair and encouraging if we take into consideration the false recognized words by the speech recognition system and the Arabic language characteristics.

title: Towards a Trajectory Ontology Design Pattern for Semantic Trajectories
abstract: Mobility data driven scientific discovery approaches became an important paradigm for computing performed in various areas including human behavior analysis. Under this paradigm, trajectory data is considered as a core revealing the trace of mobile objects displacements. While each study area presents a different optic of trajectory data, they aim to support mobility data with domain specific knowledge. Semantic annotations may offer a common model for different trajectories in view of share, exchange or integration. As a consequence, the common structures encountered in trajectory data could be annotated based on a consensual knowledge, abstracted from domain specific aspects. Ontology design patterns are promising solutions to define such trajectory related pattern. They appear more suitable for the annotation of multi perspective and heterogeneous data than the only use of domain ontologies. In this paper, we put forward an ontology design pattern for trajectories and we validate the pattern with a case study.

title: Toward an Ontology based model of key performance indicators for business process improvement
abstract: the selection and the use of performance measurement have received considerable interest in recent years. In addition, it is crucial not only to track the process behavior and to derive the key performance indicators but also to understand all necessary concepts involved in the business process (BP) and incorporate domain knowledge of the field. The improvement of business processes is based on comprehensive measurement, data understanding, task design, and relevant result interpretation of organization's performance. In this context, in order to make relevant decisions and to provide a consistent understanding of the field, we present a new ontology based on a real business process to create semantic relationships between all terms. After that, we were based on data mining technique to extract the most important information from data measurement. An example of implementation of our proposed contribution as well as its validation on a real case study in the healthcare domain is presented.

title: Towards A Decision Support Model for the Resolution of Episodic Problems based on Ontology and Case Bases Reasoning Application to Terrorism Attacks
abstract: Recently, terrorist risks are continuing to increase in the form of terrorist acts due to various and simultaneous factors. This subject is of great scientific interest and importance because our society is vulnerable and we have a low level of protection against terrorism. This paper aims at developing a decision support model, called jCatt (jCOLIBRI against terrorist attacks). The preventive model is based on acquiring and reusing past attacks historically solved to assist a decision maker. It helps to understand each terrorist attack situation and to propose possible solutions in the form of preventive and / or corrective measures. It is composed of two main parts: knowledge models described by an ontology, and a reasoning process based on Case Based Reasoning (CBR). In this paper, we present the development environment used, the architecture and in particular the various components of our model as well as the phases of the reasoning cycle.

title: PCARMS: Profile clustering based approach for recommendation in mediation systems
abstract: Nowadays, where the number of information is increasing exponentially, there is necessity to filter and deliver relevant information to the user, for this purpose, information systems are more and more interested to provide users with personalized content and services by searching through the large volume of available information, the most correspondent to users needs. This approach is called the personalization of information system and is based on the concept of user profile. The personalization can show up either by adapting the interface, filtering information or proposing recommended content to the user. In this work, we propose a user profile clustering based approach to personalize mediation systems by offering recommendations.

title: Mining gene Expression Data using gradual patterns
abstract: In the last years, the microarray technology has become a powerful tool for functional genomics. So analysis of gene expression data derived from this high throughput technology is required to extract implicit and relevant knowledge about genes. Because, it is important to understand complex relationships between genes and to investigate the genes functions, many data mining approaches are used to extract this knowledge. However, mining gene expression data is a complex process. In this paper, we list some of these approaches and we propose to use gradual patterns and gradual rules to extract from microarrays the relationships between genes and transcription factors facilitating the modeling of the dynamics of Genetic Regulation Networks. These gradual patterns applied to numerical data express correlations of the attributes values (co variations) in a database. Furthermore, we propose to integrate the gene expression data with chip seq data to better understand the mechanisms of gene regulation.

title: A Validation Architecture for an Ontology Based Real Time Database
abstract: Many solutions were proposed to store and load a big amount of semantic data which are generated from ontologies. These solutions gave raise to a new databases architecture called Ontology Based DataBases (OBDBs) which presents several drawbacks : it don't take into account the management of non standard data, it don't consider the modeling of time as well as data types, and it don't propose a specification and modeling of transactions. Based on these limits, the existed OBDBs architecture is not suitable for real time applications. The real time ontology, which is the result of temporal constraints integration on real time context, has been introduced. In this paper, we propose the integration of a real time ontology on databases. Currently, many real time applications are geographically distributed, in this case, the distributed real time DBMS are the best appropriate to be a suitable target for this integration. The performance study of integrating a real time ontology on distributed real time DBMS require the use of quality of service (QoS) based architectures which the feedback control scheduling technique is the best case. In this order, the Distributed Feedback Control Scheduling Architecture for Real Time Ontology (DFCSA RTO) is proposed.

title: Ontology Knowledge mining based similarity measure for text document
abstract: In this study, we propose to enhance the standard document vector cosine similarity basing on an ontology knowledge mining approach. The basic idea is to reorganize the ontologys concepts into a hierarchical structure of conceptual clusters of targeted subjects, where each cluster aggregates similar concepts suggesting a specific category of the domain knowledge. Similarity between the two concepts is then determined by taking the cosine angle between the two corresponding clusters. We apply the method in our domain of interest mammographic domain using an existing mammographic ontology called Mammo

title: A Review On Dynamic Stochastic Modeling of the Degradation Process: Case of Maintenance Based on Reliability and A Proposed Approach
abstract: Reliability analysis is an integral part of system design and operation. The study of maintenance based on the reliability requires prior modeling of the degradation of the considered system. This is a difficult task when the system becomes complex. The first step consists in exploiting the Return EXperience (REX) databases and the experts knowledge and advice to estimate the parameters of the model of degradation of the chosen system. The model of degradation is, then, enriched taking into account maintenance operations. Once the system and its maintenance are properly formalized, a utility function is established in order to evaluate a given maintenance strategy according to one or more given criteria.

title: Mammographic Image Based Possibilistic ontological representation
abstract: This paper represents a novel approach for ontology modeling using the possibility theory. In one hand, ontology has become the enabler of knowledge exchange among data sources. On the other hand, the possibility theory represents a powerful mean to handle uncertainty and to deal with ambiguous information. The proposed approach combines both paradigms in order to perform ontology capabilities through possibilist representation. Our approach attempts to model ontological instances from mammographic images based on possibility theory. The proposed approach has been tested over real mammographic data.

title: A parallel Semantic sentiment analysis
abstract: The analysis of feelings(Sentiment analysis or opinion mining) is the process of studying peoples opinion, emotion and how to consider an issue and make a decision into different categories like positive, negative and neutral in data mining. For example, Sentiment analysis over Twitter provides organisations and individuals with a quick and effective way to monitor public feelings, such as knowing a customers opinion about a companys product. In this paper We propose a new method to analyze the feelings of the tweets in semantic and parallelizable way using the semantic resource wordnet, By enriching the AFINN1 dictionary By the semantics, the relation of semantics used is the synonymy. To solve the problem of the times execution of the analysis if the dataset of the tweets is very large we decide to do the analysis in a parallel and distributed way using the Hadoop framework with the Hadoop Distributed File system HDFS and the programming model MapReduce. The aim of our work is to combine between several domains, the Information retrieval, semantic similarity , opinion mining or sentiment analysis and big data.

title: How to compute the student knowledge and the student disturbance
abstract: E Learning system acquired in the last decade an increasing number of students. In fact, it represents a flexible educational support for the student; it tunes automatically the studied resources according to the individual personality, needs and knowledge of the connected student; it offers a personalized service by analyzing collected data about the student. However, those students often cat off due to some mismatch with their concerns. In fact, e Learning systems generally rely on the students data observed on the e learning platform and neglect other sources of information. But, the more information we get, the more we are close to the student and his real expectations. Therefore, we propose, in this paper, the enrichment of the users model by observing his behavior on parallel opened URL(s) to deduce about his acquired knowledge and to detect bridge events that require the system intervention for appropriate recommendation to stabilize the user behavior. The main treated issues focus on, firstly, what is the useful information to observe in order to detect the real knowledge acquired by the user? Secondly, what are the critical events that disturb the user interest about some concepts? Thirdly, how the collected information is used to redirect and guide the users navigation?

title: Automatic ontology population from the text Case study: handicraft domain
abstract: Ontology population is a knowledge acquisition activity used to transform data sources into instance data. In this paper, we present an approach for automatic ontology population from text (interviews) by applying Natural Language Processing (NLP) and Information Extraction (IE) techniques to acquire and classify instances of ontology concepts. This approach was applied in the handicraft field and in the French language. This contribution has been established through the use of GATE framework that provides the ability to create JAPE rules defined by the user and to create custom word lists (Gazetteers list) according to the user requirement.

title: Ontological reasoning for understanding the behaviour of complex biomolecular networks
abstract: Analysis of biological systems is being progressively facilitated by computational tools. Most of these tools are based on qualitative and numerical methods. However, they are not always evident and there is an increasing need to provide an additional semantic layer. Semantic technologies, especially ontologies, are one of the tools frequently used for this purpose. In fact, they are indispensable for understanding the semantic knowledge about the functioning of cells on a molecular level. We describe here the biomolecular network ontology (BNO) created specially to address the needs of analysing the complex biomolecular network's behaviour. The BNO ontology is freely available at https://github.com/AliAyadi/The Biomolecular Network Ontology and can be viewed using the standard ontology visualization editor \textit{Prot\'{e}g\'{e}}. This ontology provides qualitative simulation of large and complex biomolecular networks. Therefore, in order to evaluate the efficacy of the BNO ontology we present two kinds of reasoning mechanisms. The first consists on an SWRL rule based reasoning developed using the SWRL rules editor tab, and another consists on an implementation of a rule based system under the MATLAB/SIMULINK development environment and can be freely downloaded at https://github.com/AliAyadi/QualitativeReasoningInMATLAB. Both of these reasoning mechanisms have been applied to the analysis of a real network of biological interest, the "bacteriophage T4 gene 32" use case.

title: An SOA Design Patterns Recommendation System based on Ontology
abstract: Service Oriented Architecture is an architectural style for building systems based on interacting services. To be performant, Service oriented architectures (SOA) systems must have some quality requirements (e.g., reliability, availability, and performance). SOA design patterns are proven solutions to specific problems in this context. Given the benefits they offer for software development, the SOA design patterns use is in an increasing expansion. Nonetheless, without assistance, any inexperienced designer may not take advantage of SOA design patterns due to their overwhelming number. In this paper, we propose a new approach that recommends the SOA design pattern that is adequate to the designer's modeling context. For this purpose, our approach creates a new ontology that classifies the different SOA patterns problems and their corresponding solutions. Then, the designer is asked some questions in order to determine the intention of the problem he is trying to model. Afterwards the existing list of pattern intentions are compared, in order to retrieve the pattern that corresponds to the designers needs and the adequate SOA patterns that are necessary for it. The SOA design patterns are formalized with an ontology that will be interrogated by SPARQL

title: DB2DB: An enrichment databases approach for medical domain
abstract: The quality of databases are often unsatisfactory, in term of completeness of data. Databases must be up to date to ensure the satisfaction of users. Since there are a large number of databases, an automatic enrichment approach is required. In this paper, we propose a new approach to enrich database called 'DataBase To Database' (DB2DB). This approach aligns the databases and creates an enriched database. DB2DB approach consists on comparing the components of two databases, detect the missing components, detect redundancies, combine the constraints, and create a new database. We applied our approach in the medical domain which is characterized by an important volume of scalable information. For experimentation, a platform is developed to test our approach using medical database. As a result we obtain an enrichment database with new components that are either tables, attributes, or records.

title: ECTD: Evidential Clustering and case Types Detection for case base maintenance
abstract: The key factor for the success of Case Based Reasoning (CBR) systems is the quality of their case bases as well as the time spent in case retrieval process which is mainly depending on case bases size. Indeed, the speed of the retrieval process is seriously increasing when the case base becomes so heavy. To vouch for case bases quality, a maintenance process must be provided. Hence, a field for Case Base Maintenance (CBM) emerges. However, a lot of works in CBM field suffers from some limitations and they generally reduce case bases competence during maintenance, especially when cases involving imprecise or uncertain information. To deal with these problems, we propose, in this paper, a new CBM approach named ECTD, Evidential Clustering and case Types Detection for case base maintenance, which is able to manage imperfection in cases by using belief function theory. The key idea of ECTD approach is to use machine learning technique, more accurately the evidential c means (ECM). Then, it divides cases relative to the different partitions of clusters into four types so that we can subsequently perform the case base maintenance.

title: Ontology Design Patterns for Smart Cities
abstract: Strategies are designed to mitigate a city's problems and transform it into a smart one. This transformation is repeatedly reused by cities around the world. The complexity of the multi disciplinary domain of smart cities renders this transformation hard. Therefore, the current paper presents well designed Ontology Design Patterns that model the smart city domain and conduct the process of cities transformation. The design of the Ontology Design Patterns is guided by a literature review of smart cities and by a qualitative research in three smart cities (Barcelona, London and Amsterdam).

title: HealthIoT Ontology for Data Semantic Representation and Interpretation Obtained from Medical Connected Objects
abstract: Internet of Things (IoT) covers a variety of applications including the Healthcare field. Consequently, medical objects become connected to each other with the purpose to share and exchange health data. These medical connected objects raise issues on how to ensure the analysis, interpretation and semantic interoperability of the extensive obtained health data with the purpose to make an appropriate decision. This paper proposes a HealthIoT ontology for representing the semantic interoperability of the medical connected objects and their data; while an algorithm alleviates the analysis of the detected vital signs and the decision making of the doctor. The execution of this algorithm needs the definition of several SWRL rules (Semantic Web Rule Language).

title: Ontology Enrichment Using The Extraction Of Labelled Association Rule
abstract: As web based research has become a high value added activity, it has prompted the rapid development of standard models and languages, tools to explain the semantics of data coming from the web and to reason with these data using the notions of ontology. Learning ontology is the process of acquiring (constructing or integrating) an ontology (semi ) automatically. But the structure and content of ontologies must progress over time in order to remain updated with the concepts and the knowledge of the modeled domain. Throughout their life cycle, ontology evolve to meet the different needs of change. In this article, we suggest using a labeled association rules which extracted from a collection of documents aiming to update an ontology of a domain.

title: Knowledge extraction from source code based on Hidden Markov Model : application to EPICAM
abstract: Domain ontologies are usually constructed using multiple data sources. Software source code is rarely used. However, implementation platforms evolve very often faster than business logic and evolutions are usually integrated directly into source code without updating the conceptual model. In this paper, we propose a method based on Hidden Markov Model for extracting knowledge from the source code to enrich a domain ontology. We experimented by extracting knowledge from EPICAM, a tuberculosis surveillance system and compared it with the knowledge extracted from other EPICAM data sources. We find that source code contains more knowledge than other data sources.

title: Sequential Pattern Approach for Extracting Ontological Knowledge from a Rich Annotated Corpus of the Arabic Text of the Quran
abstract: This paper describes a sequential pattern based method and its usage for extracting a different type of knowledge from a dataset collected from different available resources for the Arabic Quranic text. Our approach is based fundamentally on the use of complex patterns sets made of various defined tags for a specific sequence of items in a corpus. The extracted knowledge was tested by experimental results that show the success of our approach in identifying a predefined set of extraction tasks from the Quran.

title: OLearnWS : Web services recommender system to assist learners within e learning platforms
abstract: Recommender systems proposed in the literature recommend a variety of items. In e learning domain, these items are considered as resources for learning. In general, the more usefulness of items is important, the more effective the learning process and assimilation are for learners. The aim of this paper is to present the various limitations of the current generation of items type recommended and possible extensions with type web services and web services recommender system, as new trends and directions for future research which might lead towards the next generation of recommender systems. The present paper proposes a personalized web services recommendation approach within e learning platforms. Web services recommendation is ontology based and it aims at helping learners in their learning process by suggesting them the most appropriate learning activities from other educational platforms according to their learning activity, profile and needs. To select the best web service, we exploit a similarity measure which calculates the similarity between systems request and web services description (OWL S+LQ). Moreover, Linked Data and Rule based Reasoning contribute to infer others Web Services. Our approach has been implemented into the OLearnWS prototype (Open E Learning Web Services Recommender System).

title: Qualitative semantic spatio temporal reasoning based on description logics for modeling dynamics of spatio temporal objects in satellite images
abstract: Providing a mechanism for modeling and reasoning about the dynamics of geographic spatio temporal objects is a challenge issue and main problem due to the complex characteristics describing these objects. A spatio temporal geographical entity is defined as a set composed by spatial, temporal and semantic (thematic) dimensions, of which various types of relationships can be specified. Changes in the state of each component are the result of geographic events and processes that may occur. For instance, the change of the state of a land cover unit such as vegetation object from appearing to disappearing or from a vegetated zone to an urban one is consequence of geographic phenomena such as desertification or urbanization respectively. Remotely sensed images provide measurements and observations that can be used for the interpretation of dynamic spatio temporal objects. The observed proprieties are used to classify geographic objects and monitor change that occurs in such object. The intended paper focus to model the dynamics of spatio temporal object from a remote sensing observation viewpoint. To achieve this purpose, we exploit a domain ontology to classify geographic entities and we use the description logic extended to semantic spatio temporal concrete domain as a mechanism for semantic spatio temporal reasoning.

title: Symbolic Approximate Reasoning within Unbalanced Multi Sets: Application to Autism Diagnosis
abstract: In most daily activities, humans often use imprecise information derived from appreciation instead of exact measurements to make decisions. Multi sets allow the representation of imperfect information in a Knowledge Based System (KBS), in the multi valued logic context. New facts are deduced using approximate reasoning. In the literature, dealing with imperfect information rely on an implicit assumption: the distribution of terms is uniform on a scale ranging from 0 to 1. Nevertheless, in some cases, a sub domain of this scale may be more informative and may include more terms. In this work, we focus on approximate reasoning within these sets, known as unbalanced sets, in the context of multi valued logic. We introduce an approach based on the Generalized Modus Ponens (GMP) model using Generalized Symbolic Modifiers (GSM). The proposed model is implemented in a tool for autism diagnosis by means of unbalanced severity degrees of the Childhood Autism Rating Scale (CARS). We obtain satisfying results on the distinction between autistic and not autistic child according to psychiatrists diagnosis.

title: VisiTafsir: A Multimedia Knowledge Management System for Holy Quran Explanation
abstract: The Holy Quran is the ultimate source of knowledge in the religious beliefs of Muslims around the world. The explanation of Quran (Tafsir) is a science that is crucial to understand and interpret the texts of the Holy Quran. This science has focused for more than 14 centuries on the linguistic interpretation of the Quran text and on the context in which it has been revealed. Nowadays, multimedia resources can help to a great deal in the interpretation of the Quran for scholars, students in theology but also for anyone who would like to have a real world interpretation of the verses of Quran. In this research, we developed VisiTafsir, a knowledge management system that associates with Quran verses (Ayats) multimedia information that can enlighten and illustrate these verses from the real world. Multimedia resources are added by users and need to be organized semantically into a knowledge management system. VisiTafsir is designed to offer an attractive environment for users to understand meanings of Quranic verses through different types of multimedia resources.

title: Using a Knowledge Based Expert System Towards Autonomous Industrial Process Control
abstract: In industrial production systems, operators and engineers daily develop a degree of knowledge about some processes that, after a certain time, they become experts in the systems where they operate. In order to take advantage of this knowledge and experience, a knowledge based expert system (KBES) can be employed to model and store the inference and decision making ways of the operators in their work procedures. This article considers that in a context of higher autonomy, a KBES could be embedded, for example, coupled in a programmable logic controller (PLC), and may adjust the controller and also take control actions in a closed loop system without the direct intervention of operators. Thus, as a possible application, such systems can be developed for the task of automatic tuning of proportional integral derivative (PID) parameters of a conventional controller, an important activity in process control operational routines. The study includes a conceptual proposal for developing the application and emphasizes the importance of artificial intelligence technologies to obtain this autonomy. In addition, a numerical simulation is also presented for automatic tuning of a PID controller.

title: Computational Ontologies for a semantic representation of the Islamic knowledge
abstract: In this paper, we present our in progress project that aims to help us reading, understanding, and interpreting Islamic legislative sources. The goal of this project is divided into two main tasks which are the creation of an ontology representing the Islamic knowledge and the development of a system which can analyze this knowledge. The ultimate goal is to assist the muftis and facilitate their job.

title: Incremental Possibilistic Decision Trees in Non Specificity Approach
abstract: Possibilistic decision trees are efficient tools that handle the class values of which are stained by uncertainty. This paper proposes a new classification method that enables possibilistic decision trees to learn incrementally. Our proposed method called incremental possibilistic decision trees permits to adapt incrementally the new incoming instances by updating and restructuring an existing possibilistic decision tree instead of destructing it and rebuilding another one from the scratch.

title: Extending BPMN2 Modeler Plug In for Sensitive Business Process Representation
abstract: This paper presents a technical solution to specify and represent Sensitive Business Processes (SBPs) using BPMN 2.0, in order to identify and localize the crucial knowledge that is mobilized and created by these processes. This solution consists in developping an extended Eclipse BPMN2 Modeler plug in called K4BPMN Modeler: Knowledge for Business Process Modeling Notation Modeler to integrate and represent the knowledge dimension in SBP models. Besides, we have illustrated the practical applicability of this solution on a medical process in the context of the association of protection of the motor disabled people of Sfax Tunisia.

title: An User Interest Ontology Based on Trusted Friends Preferences for Personalized Recommendation
abstract: Based on the assumption that users generally have a tendency to use items recommended by friends rather than strangers and that trust among friends positively correlates with user preference, we decided to refer to research conducted on the emerging field of trust based recommender system. We propose to integrate the temporal factor in measuring trust between social network friends. A Trusted Friends calculation method is developed for determining social trusted friends by analyzing users profile on Facebook. Afterwards, we have represented the users model as an ontology that takes into consideration all trusted friends preferences and the degree of trust between friends. Afterwards, we have used this ontology in a semantic tourism recommender system as a smart e tourism tool able to recommend items based on the users preferences and their trusted friends preferences. Finally, we have implemented the system and collected feedback from real users to evaluate the quality of recommendation and prove its importance in improving the medical tourism domain.

title: A propos des territoires dans les corpus scientifiques
abstract: Le projet interdisciplinaire TERRE ISTEX a pour objectif didentifier levolution des fronts de recherche en relation avec les territoires detudes, les croisements disciplinaires ainsi que les modalites concretes de recherche a partir des contenus numeriques heterogenes disponibles dans les corpus scientifiques. Le projet se decompose en trois actions principales : (1) identifier les periodes et les lieux qui ont fait lobjet detudes empiriques et dont rendent compte les publications issues des corpus analyses, (2) identifier les approches (methodes et concepts) mobilisees pour la realisation de ces etudes et enfin (3) developper un demonstrateur Web de recherche dinformation geographique (RIG). Les deux premieres actions font intervenir des approches combinant des patrons du traitement automatique du langage naturel a des methodes de fouille de textes. En croisant les trois dimensions (spatial, thematique et temporel) dans un moteur de RIG, il sera ainsi possible de comprendre quelles recherches ont ete menees sur quels territoires, selon quelles approches et a quel moment. Dans le cadre du projet, les experimentations sont menees sur un corpus heterogene constitue de theses electroniques et darticles scientifiques provenant des bibliotheques numeriques dISTEX et du centre de recherche CIRAD.

title: Unsupervised relation extraction from scientific texts using self organizing maps
abstract: Scientific texts represent a rich source of unstructured knowledge. Extracting this knowledge in a supervised manner can become highly expensive in time and human resources. Moreover, supervised models are domain and language dependent which make them hard to maintain and extend. Hence unsupervised methods have received a lot of attention from researchers in the fields of information extraction and data mining.
